name: art-landscape
purpose: Draw a landscape as dark and light SVG in the design tokens' colours (board, blueprint or paper): hills, mountains, dunes or sea at dawn, day, dusk or night, layered far to near, still or looping.
examples: a mountain scene at dusk for my landing page
a looping sea at night as an svg

out.description: the file stem: STEM-dark.svg and STEM-light.svg are written

title.description: what a screen reader says the picture is

style.description: the design tokens the colours come from

time.description: the light: where the sun (or the moon) sits and the sky's colours

terrain.description: what the layers are: rolling hills, snow-capped ridges, sand dunes, or a sea under a headland

layers.description: how many layers deep, far to near, each nearer one darker (a sea draws at most 3 bands of waves)

seed.description: another seed draws another landscape from the same slots

motion.description: one loop's length as a CSS duration (clouds and waves drift, stars twinkle), or none for a still picture
